Questions

What is the median annual wage for Elementary teachers in Austin?

The OEWS May 2025 annual median for Elementary School Teachers, Except Special Education in Austin-Round Rock-San Marcos, TX is $61,270.

Does OEWS publish an hourly wage for Elementary teachers in Austin?

No. OEWS May 2025 does not publish hourly mean or median for Elementary School Teachers, Except Special Education in Austin-Round Rock-San Marcos, TX. WageGrid shows annual wages only and does not convert annual to hourly.

How many Elementary teachers work in Austin?

OEWS May 2025 estimates 8,450 wage-and-salary Elementary School Teachers, Except Special Education in Austin-Round Rock-San Marcos, TX. Self-employed workers are excluded.

What is the location quotient for Elementary teachers in Austin?

The OEWS May 2025 location quotient is 0.73. Values above 1.00 mean Elementary School Teachers, Except Special Education are more concentrated in Austin-Round Rock-San Marcos, TX than in the national occupational mix.

What is the mean annual wage for Elementary teachers in Austin?

The OEWS May 2025 annual mean for Elementary School Teachers, Except Special Education in Austin-Round Rock-San Marcos, TX is $60,310.

How does Austin's Elementary teachers median compare to the other WageGrid metros?

Austin's published OEWS May 2025 annual median ($61,270) is $17,120 lower than Chicago ($78,390) and $41,650 lower than Seattle ($102,920). These are published medians minus published medians. WageGrid does not adjust for cost of living.

Does this wage include self-employed workers?

No. OEWS estimates cover wage-and-salary workers and exclude the self-employed. WageGrid does not add a self-employment figure.

Why is a wage cell blank?

BLS withholds some OEWS estimates for quality or confidentiality. WageGrid does not fill those cells.
